items.title: Turn Daily Rite segment policy into deterministic room-clear outcomes
items.why: The S67 policy changes monster drops and public status, but clearing a room still mostly advances the wave with copy. Solara should make route pressure physically legible: scarce recovery, coin caches, sunstone bargains, and rival-risk rooms need a shared zero-token outcome contract.
items.recipe: Add `src/game/dailyRiteRoomOutcome.js` that derives deterministic heal/prayer/coin/sunstone outcome receipts from the active segment policy, room weave, wave, and day seed; cover it with Node tests.

items.title: Wire room-clear outcome receipts into the active Daily Rite loop
items.why: The player should not have to infer policy from status JSON. Applying a pure outcome receipt in `App.jsx` lets the browser loop grant bounded resources, print segment-specific receipts, and keep `App.jsx` from becoming the policy source of truth.
items.recipe: Use the new outcome contract when a Daily Rite wave clears; apply bounded HP/prayer/coin/item rewards and append sanitized receipt lines before spawning the next room.

items.title: Expose a public Daily Rite outcome policy digest for Studio surfaces
items.why: Studio integrations can see the segment policy, but not what a clear actually pays or restores. A compact digest lets public surfaces preview today's recovery/caches/shrine bargain posture without paid generation or leaking private planning.
items.recipe: Export a sanitized `daily_rite_outcomes` digest through chronicle/status integrations with `token_cost: 0`, strongest recovery, richest cache, and shrine-bargain posture.

items.title: Make validation prove active Daily Rite room outcomes exist
items.why: The current smoke contract proves active stakes, modifiers, policy, and segment mapping. It should also prove a started run exposes deterministic outcome receipts so runtime reward/recovery wiring cannot silently regress.
items.recipe: Extend tests and smoke validation to assert active Daily Rite runs carry zero-token outcome policy and room-clear receipts derived from the same segment policy.

skipped.reason: Still valuable, but this repo does not yet carry a browser runner; keep this pass dependency-free and preserve zero browser token cost.
Rejected by Solara's deterministic-first policy; route intelligence remains structured and generated locally.

executionLog.evidence: Added `src/game/dailyRiteRoomOutcome.js` with deterministic zero-token room-clear receipts, bounded heal/prayer/coin/sunstone rewards, and a public digest builder.
`src/App.jsx` now applies the Daily Rite room outcome receipt after each cleared wave, mutating only bounded HP/prayer/inventory rewards and printing receipt/next-action lines.
`buildPublicChronicle` and `generate-public-status` now export `daily_rite_outcomes` through shared-world, integration, and status surfaces with `token_cost: 0`.
Unit tests now cover deterministic outcome receipts and public digest sanitization; smoke validation asserts active Daily Rite runs expose zero-token outcome policy and latest room outcome.
